title: Vietnam payroll plan legal and architecture cross-check
preparation_status: U01-U05, architecture A, detailed-design sections 1-6, the simple-premium UX contract, and the Codex/Hermes execution contract are owner-approved at the design layer. The consolidated design specification and task-by-task TDD implementation plan are written and statically reviewed. Runtime, specialist sign-off, integration, and production evidence are not run.

design_approval.architecture: Windows-native modular monolith; Next.js/TypeScript; PostgreSQL; deterministic payroll domain; PostgreSQL outbox; protected local documents; attendance-only Cloudflare ingress; no Docker dependency for MVP
design_approval.ux_contract: Vietnamese-first, easy, low-step, accessible, and visually premium without hiding payroll evidence
design_approval.execution_contract: Codex-direct or bounded Hermes packets; Codex owns integration and independent evidence review
